payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the models used for cyberbullying detection, including improvements in recall and precision scores with different transfer learning approaches.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance than their counterparts (F, T, W).
Transfer Learning TL2 resulted in a dramatic improvement in recall scores compared to TL1.
Precision also improved significantly with TL2, indicating better performance of the models.
Using TL1, the Formspring dataset achieved higher precision and recall when using Wikipedia as the base model compared to Twitter.
